d: We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused English Call Center Agent (CX) to join our team. As a CX Agent, you will play a key role in ensuring that our clients have a seamless and positive experience with our team. You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and optimizing the end-to-end customer journey. This role requires a proactive, solutions-oriented individual who is fluent in English and has a passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
q: li
Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
li
Bachelor's degree with an English Background is a plus.
li
1-3 years of experience in customer service, customer experience
li
Experience with customer service platforms, CRM tools.
li
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
li
Capacity to handle challenging situations with professionalism and empathy.
li
Strong customer service orientation with a passion for delivering high-quality solutions.
li
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
r: li
Design and implement customer journey mapping to optimize the end-to-end customer experience, identifying pain points and opportunities for improvement.
li
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring that their needs are fully understood and addressed in a timely manner to meet and exceed expectations.
li
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer feedback is used to enhance products.
li
Maintain a high standard of customer service by addressing all inquiries and issues with professionalism and empathy.
li
Ensure a positive experience for customers at all touchpoints, from initial contact through to resolution and follow-up.
li
Monitor and track performance metrics, such as response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, ensuring consistent improvement.

d: Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.
Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.
q: li
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
li
Minimum 10 years of experience in hotel sales and marketing, with at least 5 years in a senior management or leadership position.
li
Proven experience in managing sales and marketing operations for large-scale hotels, preferably properties with 500+ rooms.
li
Previous experience with international hotel brands is highly preferred, particularly Accor.
li
Proven track record in achieving revenue targets, increasing hotel occupancy, and improving market share.
li
Strong knowledge of hotel revenue management principles, including ADR, RevPAR, and occupancy forecasting.
li
Extensive experience in developing business relationships with Hajj and Umrah operators, corporate accounts, travel agencies, and international tour operators.
li
Excellent understanding of hotel distribution channels, online travel agencies (OTAs), digital marketing, and brand positioning.
li
Strong leadership, team management, negotiation, and business development skills.
li
Excellent financial, analytical, and strategic planning abilities.
li
Proficiency in hotel management systems, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.
li
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Arabic is highly preferred.
li
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
li
Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and deliver results in a dynamic hospitality environment.
r: li
Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximize hotel revenue, occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), and RevPAR.
li
Lead, manage, and motivate the Sales & Marketing team, ensuring the achievement of departmental objectives and key performance indicators.
li
Identify and develop new business opportunities across key market segments, including Hajj and Umrah operators, corporate accounts, travel agencies, tour operators, and international markets.
li
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, strategic partners, travel agencies, and corporate accounts to generate consistent business opportunities.
li
Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, digital marketing initiatives, and promotional activities to strengthen the hotel's brand presence and market positioning.
li
Develop and manage the annual sales and marketing budget, ensuring effective resource allocation and achievement of financial targets.
li
Work closely with the Revenue Management team to develop pricing strategies, sales forecasts, market positioning, and distribution plans.
li
Monitor market trends, competitor performance, customer preferences, and industry developments to identify opportunities and maintain a competitive advantage.
li
Oversee key sales activities, including corporate negotiations, group bookings, international business development, client visits, and participation in industry events and trade shows.
li
Manage the hotel's online presence and distribution channels, including the hotel's website, online travel agencies (OTAs), and other digital platforms, in coordination with relevant departments.
li
Analyze sales performance, market share, campaign results, and revenue reports to evaluate effectiveness and implement corrective actions when required.
li
Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with hotel brand standards, company policies, and established operational procedures.
li
Collaborate with the General Manager and other department heads to align commercial strategies with the hotel's overall business objectives and operational requirements.
li
Prepare and present regular sales performance reports, market updates, business forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior management.
li
Drive continuous improvement, team development, and a customer-focused approach to support the hotel's long-term commercial success.
